posts.name: umra
posts.cooked: Someone please tell me that till now all the BPTs that I have done were done from another laptop. Now if we use another laptop for oppe, will we have to create a new ssh.key for oppe vm?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: If you want to use a different laptop, you can copy your laptop’s existing public key or if there is none then generate a new key using ssh-keygen and paste the public key in OPPE vm. If you are facing issues, you can join support session at 9 pm (link in your calendar).
